settings.overview: Manage your library, Jellyfin connection, account, and language.
settings.crowdin_info: Translations are synchronized with Crowdin. To add new languages or refine translations, join the project on Crowdin.
settings.music_dir_desc: Path where Sonalis will save downloaded audio files and look for .lrc synchronized lyric files.
settings.jellyfin_detected_paths_desc: Jellyfin has no media upload API. It scans audio files directly from the server disk. Files downloaded by Sonalis must go into this storage so Jellyfin can index them.
settings.jellyfin_path_not_detected: No music path detected yet. Verify your Jellyfin connection.
settings.jellyfin_path_match_note: Your local path matches the storage folder monitored by Jellyfin.
settings.jellyfin_path_diff_warning: Important: Jellyfin reads music from {path}. Because Jellyfin cannot receive files via API, this folder must point to the same physical storage (e.g. through a Docker volume mapping or an SMB/NFS network share).
settings.docker_note_body: When running in Docker, make sure this path matches the volume mount defined in docker-compose.yml (e.g. ./music:/music).
settings.jellyfin_section_desc: Connect your Jellyfin server for instant library scanning, playlist selection, and audio playback.
settings.jellyfin_api_key_help: Create one in Jellyfin Dashboard > Advanced > API Keys.
settings.users_section_desc: Manage the active Jellyfin session or switch accounts.
settings.import_desc: Pick a folder on the server or upload files from this device. Sonalis identifies each track and moves it into the library as Artist / Album (Year) / Artist - Album - NN - Title.
settings.import_folder_audio: {count} audio files directly in this folder (subfolders are included)
settings.import_nothing: No audio files found in this folder.
settings.import_done: Imported {count} tracks. Jellyfin is refreshing the library.
settings.import_error_generic: The import could not be completed.
settings.import_error_busy: Another import is already running. Try again when it finishes.
settings.import_error_folder_not_allowed: This folder is outside the music library and the import folder.
settings.import_error_no_audio: No supported audio files were selected.
settings.import_error_unsupported_file: A file type is not supported.
settings.import_error_file_too_large: A file is larger than 200 MB.
settings.import_error_too_many_files: Too many files in one upload (maximum 5000).
settings.import_error_upload_not_found: The upload expired. Select the files again.
settings.import_error_job_not_found: This import expired. Start it again.
settings.import_error_job_not_ready: This import is not ready yet.
settings.import_error_apply_failed: Moving the tracks failed. Check the folder permissions.
settings.import_duplicates_question: {count} tracks are already in the library. What should happen to the extra copies?
settings.import_duplicates_keep_upload: Do not import them (they are discarded with the upload)
settings.import_duplicates_delete: Delete them and keep only the best quality (for example FLAC instead of MP3), moved into the right folder
settings.import_done_deleted: Imported {count} tracks and deleted {deleted} duplicates. Jellyfin is refreshing the library.
settings.dir_missing: Folder not found. It will be created when you save.
settings.import_desc_short: Pick a folder on the server or upload files from this device. Each track is identified and moved into the library using this layout:
settings.jellyfin_api_key_placeholder: Paste the API key generated by Jellyfin
settings.jellyfin_needs_config: Enter the server URL and API key to connect.
settings.jellyfin_unreachable: Could not reach the Jellyfin server.
settings.jellyfin_user_help: Used for playlists when nobody is signed in.
settings.music_dir_help: Make sure this path matches the volume mounted in Docker or on the NAS.
settings.setup_wizard_desc: Walk through the server, storage, and account setup again.
settings.storage_sync_title: Jellyfin reads music from a different path
settings.leave_unsaved_confirm: You have unsaved settings. Leave without saving?
settings.import_drop_hint: Drop audio files here, or use one of the options below.
settings.storage_mismatch_summary: Folder is writable, but Jellyfin reads music from a different path
settings.use_this_path_hint: Only use this if Sonalis sees the same folder at this path
settings.url_invalid: Start the address with http:// or https://
settings.health_desc: Find files whose name, folder, or tags disagree, such as an instrumental saved under the original title. Nothing changes until you pick a fix.
settings.health_confirm_delete: Delete "{path}" and its lyrics? This cannot be undone.
settings.health_more: {count} more not shown. Fix or ignore some, then check again.
settings.import_error_issue_not_found: This problem is no longer in the list. Check the library again.
settings.import_error_fix_not_allowed: This fix is not available for this file.
settings.import_error_target_exists: A file with the new name already exists.
settings.import_tag_failures: Tags could not be written to {count} files; see the import log.
settings.accent_desc: Colors the logo, buttons and highlights across the app.
settings.crossfade_desc: Fade out the end of each song while the next one fades in.
settings.alias_desc: Map a former or alternate artist name (as Deezer shows it) to the name used in your library. Album and artist pages then find releases listed under the other name, and new downloads are saved under the library name. Aliases are also added automatically when an album is found under another name.
settings.alias_error_alias_same_name: The two names are the same.
settings.alias_error_alias_duplicate: That name already has an alias.
settings.alias_error_invalid_aliases: Enter both names (up to 200 characters each).
settings.alias_error_config_not_saved: The aliases could not be saved.
settings.guide_link: Settings guide: what each setting does and why it exists

replace.title: Change file
replace.hint: Pick the right song among the search results and listen to the previews. Title, artist, album, cover and lyrics stay as they are: only the audio changes, and playlists keep the song.
replace.preview_error: This file could not be played.
replace.confirm: Replace the audio of "{title}" with "{candidate}"? The tags stay the same and the previous file is kept for 30 days.
replace.queued: Replacing the file of {title}. When Activity says it is done, the library already plays the new audio.
replace.error_file_not_found: This server cannot reach the song's file: it is not inside its music folder. Use the Sonalis instance that runs next to the library.
replace.error_item_not_found: Jellyfin no longer has this song. Reload the library and try again.
replace.error_invalid_request: This song cannot be changed (it is not a library file).
replace.becomes_mp3: The new audio is not lossless, so this {format} file becomes an MP3.

edit.title: Edit file
edit.hint: Drag the two handles to keep only the song: cut video intros, outros, and silence. The cut is lossless; tags, cover, and synced lyrics stay aligned.
edit.confirm: Keep only {start} – {end} of "{title}"? The previous file is kept for 30 days.
